appOverview: Dashboard is the landing screen right after a successful login. A top navbar (logo placeholder on the left; a disabled Configuración icon, 'Bienvenido, <nombre>', and a Salir link on the right) sits above a responsive grid of seven large cards — Calendario, Criterios de evaluación, Unidades de Trabajo, Listado de alumnos, Diario, Vista individual de alumno, and Informes — each a link into its own not-yet-built view. Only a signed-in teacher can reach it: on load it checks GET /api/auth/session and redirects to /login on a 401. Salir ends the session (POST /api/auth/logout) and returns to /login. Domain: Formación Profesional (Canarias) — the seven sections are organized by ciclo formativo and módulo profesional, not by curso/área.

businessRules: Always rendered disabled — never opens a menu, never looks interactive
Exposes a non-availability indicator (e.g. aria-disabled or a tooltip/label) rather than silently doing nothing when clicked

elementSpecs.behavior: Shows 'Bienvenido, ' followed by the signed-in teacher's full name, read from the session.
businessRules: The name shown is exactly the full_name the current session resolves to (GET /api/auth/session) — never a locally-cached or guessed value
acceptanceCriteria: Shows 'Bienvenido, ' followed by the signed-in teacher's full name once the session check resolves

elementSpecs.behavior: Ends the current session and returns the user to /login when clicked.

After the logout response, redirects to /login regardless of the response body
Once logged out, a later visit to /dashboard with the same (now-invalid) session must redirect to /login instead of rendering the Dashboard

globalRules: The Dashboard is reachable only with a valid session: on load, it calls GET /api/auth/session; a 401 response redirects to /login instead of rendering the Dashboard
The seven section cards render in this fixed order: Calendario, Criterios de evaluación, Unidades de Trabajo, Listado de alumnos, Diario, Vista individual de alumno, Informes
None of the seven cards' destination routes exist yet — each is out of scope beyond navigating there
Configuración never appears interactive in this view — it's an explicit, non-functional placeholder, not a stub pretending to work
Multi-teacher/role differences beyond showing the signed-in teacher's own name are out of scope for this view
